تكتنفوا (form VIII)
# تَكْتَنِفُوا (taktanifū) /tak.ta.ni.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
# تُكْتَنَفُوا (tuktanafū) /tuk.ta.na.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَنَفَ (iktanafa)
